theme.description: Default to Light theme for document legibility. Provide Dark mode tailored for long-session 'power users' to reduce eye strain.

typography.guidelines: Use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight) for large headers (>32px). Use Uppercase + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]) for overlines and confidence labels. The jump between a heading and subheading must not exceed 2 Tailwind steps. Do NOT use Inter or Roboto.

colors.archetype: Swiss High-Contrast mixed with Old Money Tech
colors.guidelines: Never use pure #000000. Ensure all text meets APCA standards. Color is function. Use accents (Red/Green) primarily to indicate AI confidence scores or validation states. DO NOT use Teal Green or Teal Blue for dashboards. Forbidden color for AI: #7351B7.

visual enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-border/40 for a 'Technical Grid' look on the dashboard.
visual enhancers.shadows: Minimal. Use crisp 1px borders to separate elements instead of soft fuzzy shadows.
visual enhancers.surfaces: Use 'Glassmorphism' (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 or bg-black/60) with a 1px delicate inner stroke for floating sticky headers and overlays. Use 'Solid Background' with a hard bottom border for standard navs. DO NOT use complete transparent backgrounds for dropdowns or floating menus.
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise/grain overlay on the marketing hero section to kill 'digital flatness'.

grids.marketing_grid: The 'Tetris' Grid (Bento) protocol. Wide gaps (gap-8). Asymmetrical structure mixing tall, square, and filler elements. Heavy typography and overlapping sections.
grids.dashboard_grid: High Density Grid. Tight gaps (gap-4). F-Pattern scanning. Every pixel utilized. Use h-full to stretch children.

marketing.strategy: High visual impact, storytelling. Overlapping elements, bento layouts, and aggressive asymmetry.
marketing.hero: Max overlay opacity: bg-black/40. Image must breathe. Minimalist luxury.

dashboard.strategy: Operational, action-driven layout. Drag-and-drop widgets. Top-left always features the 'North Star' metric (e.g., Document Extractions). Use visible grid lines (border-r border-b) for data-heavy sections.
dashboard.sidebar: Clean, dense navigation. Collapsible for power users.

components.buttons: Pill-shaped or sharp rectangular depending on context. Primary buttons use the Midnight Slate background with White text. Explicit hover states (e.g., hover:bg-slate-800 hover:text-white).
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border, no shadow. Hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and shadow-lg.
components.charts: Standardized charting (Line for trends, Bar for categories). Avoid donut charts unless displaying confidence distribution (<3 vars). Do not require hover for basic data.
components.tables: Dense. Left-aligned data. Use IBM Plex Mono for numerical data and case citations.
components.status_badges: Critical for AI transparency. Display 'Confidence Scores' explicitly next to extracted entities (High/Medium/Low).

motion.guidelines: Minimalist on dashboard (micro-interactions, fast hover states). High on marketing (parallax, scroll-triggered fades). Respect prefers-reduced-motion. Staggered entrances for list items.

accessibility.guidelines: Minimum 4.5:1 contrast for normal text. Explicit focus states with ring-2. All interactive elements must include 'data-testid' (e.g., data-testid='upload-document-button'). Provide empty states with clear CTAs (e.g., 'Upload your first NDA').

media.icon_guidelines: Use Phosphor Icons (Duotone for marketing, Regular for dense dashboards). Do NOT use AI emoji icons.

3d libraries.recommendation: D3.js for 'Data Art' visualizations of case law citations and document extraction links. TS Particles for subtle, high-performance background networking effects on the marketing page.
3d libraries.usage: Do NOT use D3 for simple bar charts. Use it strictly for visualizing complex legal connections (e.g., Case A cites Case B). Backgrounds should be transparent to blend with UI.

image_urls.description: Classic bookshelf. Use to represent legal heritage and trust.
Modern office glass doors representing the tech-forward, transparent nature of the AI platform.
Abstract metal structure representing AI's neural connections and structural document parsing.
Gavel and scales of justice. Good for the 'Case Law Lookup' feature highlight.

instructions_to_main_agent.setup: Install @phosphor-icons/react for icons. Configure Tailwind with the provided color palette and fonts (Cormorant Garamond, IBM Plex Sans, IBM Plex Mono).
instructions_to_main_agent.file_conventions: You have .js files not .tsx file, so share the guideline for .js files not for .tsx files. Use .jsx/.js extensions for all new components and strictly avoid TypeScript types in those files.
instructions_to_main_agent.routing: Create a clear separation between the Marketing landing page (/) and the App Dashboard (/app or /workspace).
instructions_to_main_agent.testing: Ensure EVERY interactive element has a 'data-testid' attribute (e.g., data-testid='login-submit').
instructions_to_main_agent.ui_library: Use Shadcn UI components but heavily customize them. Strip the 'Vercel-look'. Make them crisp (1px borders, minimal shadow).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Build a creative, distinct frontend.
Do not use dark colors as gradients.
Do not make generic centered layouts. Use F-Pattern for dashboards and asymmetrical Tetris grid for marketing.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur). NEVER use purely transparent backgrounds for overlays.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific properties to avoid breaking transforms.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Do not add '.App { text-align: center; }' in the css file.
Always use modern button styles (pill-shaped or sharp) with interaction animations.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (like 🤖🧠) for icons. Use Phosphor Icons.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Use padding inside bordered containers.
Main agent must use the provided image URLs. NEVER use placeholder URLs like via.placeholder.com.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui.
GENERAL UI UX DESIGN GUIDELINES: Always explicitly set text color on hover. Do not rely on inheritance.
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-6 or p-8) to prevent text collision.
Mobile Height Limit: Images MUST NOT exceed 80vh on mobile devices.
Optical alignment over geometrical alignment (e.g., button with round icon).
Subgrid Support: When wrapper elements are necessary, use subgrid to maintain layout integrity.
Ensure hover state color is a lighter hue of the active state color.
Only use primary/brand color for CTAs like buttons and forms. Limit the use of primary colors to maintain visual hierarchy.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute to facilitate robust automated testing.
